entries.name: sf_blank_number_is_null
entries.statement: In a Salesforce validation rule a blank number is null and any numeric comparison on it is false.
entries.evidence: Dev org probe 2026-09-13 (scripts/seed_salesforce.py): blank Amount saved under `Amount <= 0`, Amount 0 rejected.

entries.name: at_blank_number_is_zero
entries.statement: In Airtable a blank number behaves as 0 in comparisons.
entries.evidence: Real base probe 2026-09-13 (scripts/smoke_airtable_naive.py): `{Amount}<=0` matched the blank record, `{Amount}<0` did not.

entries.name: sf_percent_scale_100
entries.statement: Salesforce percent fields store 50 for 50%; formula literals are in the same units.
entries.evidence: Opportunity describe: Probability type percent precision 3 scale 0; Salesforce field-type docs.

entries.name: at_percent_scale_1
entries.evidence: Airtable field model docs; base schema percent precision 2.

entries.name: picklist_eq_on_blank_false
entries.statement: ISPICKVAL / select equality on a blank value is false in both systems; <> is its negation.
entries.evidence: Salesforce formula docs; Airtable formula behaviour. Not probed empirically.
